newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Feb index rises to 56.2.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Feb index rises to 56.2.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 56.2 in February from a 55.9 in January, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Friday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index fell to 56.0 in February from a 57.4 in January.
The employment component of the barometer fell to 49.9 in February from 51.1 in January.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the Chicagoland business barometer "continues to show economic growth as it inched ahead 0.3 point in February."
The group said employment showed little change and prices were held in check.
It also said February's expansion in new orders waned as that component dropped to an 11-month low. It added that supplier deliveries in February reached the highest level in two years.
